## policy_side_notes (not verdicts)
- Base farmland_agg_combined_ltv states an order of its own ("When the combined test fails, the release or closing proceeds only after the member pays principal down on the loan concerned until the test is met"); rendered faithfully in combined_ltv_test_9980f425. In this world the combined test is met after the release (62.87% <= 75), so it adds no hop.
- The paydown prerequisite bears weight only through the post-split factors: with the baseline limit (75) the state already holds and the fall-back paydown is 0.00. This is the policy design (factors decide the edge), recorded for transparency.
